entries.title: Deno cannot read index configuration
entries.root_cause: The Deno run command lacks permission to read the SILT_INDEX_MODE environment variable. Grant environment access for that variable.

entries.title: Missing local normalize module
entries.root_cause: The import in src/compose.ts points to the nonexistent local file src/normalise.ts; the actual module is src/normalize.ts. Correct the import path.

entries.title: Missing local schema module
entries.root_cause: The import in src/reader.ts references src/schema.ts, which was omitted from the checkout because it was never committed. Add the missing module to the repository.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e2, Deno cannot resolve a local TypeScript module, but this module must be added rather than correcting a misspelled import.
